headline_result: The two local repairs and delivery cutoffs were supported; identical delivered inputs still produced fills of 3 versus 1.

result_records.title: Restricted simulator repair and delivered observations
result_records.summary: Restricted simulator readiness accepted: independent reconstruction supports the two local native repairs and actual participant-delivery cutoffs. Identical delivered inputs can still lead to fills3 versus1. This is ambiguity, not recoverability. Next: a frozen controlled study comparing direct prediction, point reconstruction and uncertainty-preserving reconstruction.
limitations: R026 / RV024 / D036. Finite recorded-capture reconstruction; no fresh reviewer engine rerun, complete history certification, adversarial exchange, market realism or learner result. Seven examples are exposed fixtures. Original real Q16/Q17/Q18 remain open.
